answer: Stake-bond slashing at the island: each PoA identity posts a 5 ETH bond, and per-epoch rewards are capped at 0.01 ETH. The inlet enforcement: equivocation or failed attestation slashes 100% of bond within one finalized slot. Attacker breakeven exceeds 500 epochs; honest single operators stay profitable. Bond capital lockup plus instant slashing makes identity farming strictly negative-EV, which is why it works.
